What does a valid Nostr signature actually prove?

Our video follows a post through its seven event fields: pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content, id and sig. The companion guide covers kind 1 posts, kind 0 profiles and kind 7 reactions.

Verification binds signed data to a key. It does not establish a real name, make a claim true or keep linked media available. Even the signed timestamp is supplied by the author.
